targets.note: The Add sheet as it opens: the plus tile in the title, one search, the row of app icons, the single hint line, and Add to Mine with Cancel and Add. No name or fields yet.
An app picked (Stripe): its icon lit in the row, the name, and a row per key. The prototype side picks the same app.
A .env pasted anywhere in the sheet: the status line with Undo and a row per line.
The item page: the who line from the grants, the Fields and .env tabs, Copy as .env, the .env card, and Who can use it with a level on each person and agent.
